title: 1565 - The Great Siege Trailer
author: Every-Leave7093
selftext:
I had a go at making a trailer for the point and click I have been working on for the last year. 

I'm quite proud of the result.. Tell me what you think!

I used AI to deconstruct a trailer of a similar game I liked and try to emulate that whilst making it my own. 

https://dfenech1982.itch.io/1565-the-great-siege

If you'd like to support follow the itch.io site.

To be released on September 8th for FREE. 🙂

comments.author: davesoft
comments.body: Eeeey, a game with some heart, finally

replies.author: Every-Leave7093
replies.body: Thanks! That genuinely means a lot. I poured a lot of time into the research, the puzzles, and learning how to make the world feel alive. I started this project with almost no experience, so hearing someone say it has heart is probably one of the best compliments I could get.
